wind.meaning: A4MC gameplay mean wind plus bounded gust contribution at the query position; Skyforge adds no second wind model.

updraft.meaning: Signed vertical usable wind signal supplied by A4MC; positive values are updraft.

downdraft.meaning: Negative values of A4MC's signed vertical usable wind signal represent downdraft; there is no separate downdraft field or Skyforge downdraft model.

turbulence.meaning: A4MC gameplay turbulence magnitude; Skyforge adds no remapping and does not assume a [0,1] upper bound.

shear.meaning: A4MC gameplay local shear magnitude per block; Skyforge adds no new bound or scaling.

altitude.meaning: Query A4MC at the consumer's actual world position; Skyforge defines no separate altitude atmosphere model.

pressure.meaning: A4MC pressure anomaly or local solver pressure proxy. Skyforge does not reinterpret it as normalized physical pressure and defines no altitude-to-pressure curve.

trust_and_freshness.fallback: GameplayWindSample.ZERO / inert consumer behavior when unavailable or untrusted
trust_and_freshness.meaning: Use A4MC gameplay authority and source metadata; Skyforge adds no competing trust model. GameplayWindSample exposes source epochs rather than a sourceAgeTicks field.

thermal_identity.test_identity: controlled A4MC authority state plus query position
thermal_identity.meaning: Bootstrap guidance/tests identify shared lift through deterministic A4MC field sampling and provenance, not a new persistent thermal entity.

ownership_and_reconstruction.save_reload_rule: Reconstruct by querying the A4MC authority after reload; never serialize a duplicate Skyforge atmosphere field.
ownership_and_reconstruction.server_rule: Gameplay authority is sampled on the server; semantic truth must not depend on a rendering backend.
ownership_and_reconstruction.implementation_proof: Issue #495 must still prove bounded update cost, dedicated-server safety, deterministic fixture behavior, and reload/reconstruction against the pinned runtime.

consumers.aircraft: Retained A4MC/Create Aeronautics compatibility may consume the same installed A4MC provider directly.
consumers.player_glider: Thin Skyforge compatibility code consumes trusted AeroMinecraftWindApi.sampleGameplay output without creating weather state.
consumers.soaring_fauna: Behavior planning consumes the same trusted AeroMinecraftWindApi.sampleGameplay authority without creating weather state.

shared_truth_rule: Consumers may interpret atmospheric truth differently, but must not own or fork per-consumer wind, thermal, turbulence, shear, or pressure state.
not_authorized: regional climatology or Phase-4 atmosphere expansion

provenance.role: gameplay sampling entrypoint and trust/freshness policy
server-side Minecraft gameplay sampling adapter and GAMEPLAY_SERVER_ONLY default
exact server gameplay sample policy names and trust boundary
deterministic public sampling and shared-provider semantics
accepted single-authority, soaring-fauna, and Reliable Gliders shared-lift boundaries
